61375-the-historical-geography-of-europe.title: Europe
61375-the-historical-geography-of-europe.creator: Unknown
61375-the-historical-geography-of-europe.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. It is really a very humble one. It aims at little more than tracing out the extent of various states at different times, and at attempting to place the various changes in their due relation to one another and to their causes. I am not, strictly speaking, writing history. I have little to do with the internal affairs of any country.

arxiv-1711-10776.title: Energy Efficient Resource Allocation in Machine-to-Machine Communications with Multiple Access and Energy Harvesting for IoT This work was supported in part by the National Nature Science Foundation of China under grants 61471114, 61372106 & 61221002, in part by the Six Talent Peaks project in Jiang
arxiv-1711-10776.creator: Zhaohui Yang, Wei Xu, , Yijin Pan, Cunhua Pan, and Ming Chen
arxiv-1711-10776.description: A 2017 arXiv research paper by Zhaohui Yang, Wei Xu, , Yijin Pan, Cunhua Pan, and Ming Chen. This paper studies energy efficient resource allocation for a machine-to-machine (M2M) enabled cellular network with non-linear energy harvesting, especially focusing on two different multiple access strategies, namely non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) and time division multiple access (TDMA). Our goal is to minimize the total energy consumption of the network via joint power control and time allocation while taking into account circuit power consumption.

arxiv-1902-10486.title: On Tiny Episodic Memories in Continual Learning
arxiv-1902-10486.creator: Arslan Chaudhry, Marcus Rohrbach, Mohamed Elhoseiny, Thalaiyasingam Ajanthan, Puneet K. Dokania, Philip H. S. Torr, Marc’Aurelio Ranzato
arxiv-1902-10486.description: Abstract In continual learning (CL), an agent learns from a stream of tasks leveraging prior experience to transfer knowledge to future tasks. It is an ideal framework to decrease the amount of supervision in the existing learning algorithms. But for a successful knowledge transfer, the learner needs to remember how to perform previous tasks.

arxiv-2012-02204.title: Localization on a synthetic Hall cylinder
arxiv-2012-02204.creator: Ren Zhang, Yangqian Yan, Qi Zhou
arxiv-2012-02204.description: Abstract By engineering laser-atom interactions, both Hall ribbons and Hall cylinders as fundamental theoretical tools in condensed matter physics have recently been synthesized in laboratories. Here, we show that turning a synthetic Hall ribbon into a synthetic Hall cylinder could naturally lead to localization.

arxiv-2101-00764.title: Compact Molecular Gas Distribution in Quasar Host Galaxies Astropy ( Astropy Collaboration et al. 2013 ; Price-Whelan et al. 2018 ) , CASA ( McMullin et al. 2007 ) , emcee ( Foreman-Mackey et al. 2013 ) , kinemetry ( Krajnović et al. 2006 ) , lmfit ( Newville et al. 2014 ) , matplotlib ( Hunter 2007
arxiv-2101-00764.creator: Juan Molina, Ran Wang, Jinyi Shangguan, Luis C. Ho, Franz E. Bauer, Ezequiel Treister, Yali Shao
arxiv-2101-00764.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Juan Molina, Ran Wang, Jinyi Shangguan, Luis C. Ho, Franz E. Bauer, Ezequiel Treister, Yali Shao. We use Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array CO(2–1) observations of six low-redshift Palomar-Green quasars to study the distribution and kinematics of the molecular gas of their host galaxies at kpc-scale resolution.

arxiv-2102-01672.title: The GEM Benchmark: Natural Language Generation, its Evaluation and Metrics
arxiv-2102-01672.creator: Sebastian Gehrmann, 9, * Tosin Adewumi, 20,21 Karmanya Aggarwal, 14 Pawan Sasanka Ammanamanchi, 15 Aremu Anuoluwapo, 21,38 Antoine Bosselut, 28 Khyathi Raghavi Chandu, 2 Miruna Clinciu, 7,11,35 Dipanjan Das, 9 Kaustubh D. Dhole, 1 Wanyu Du, 42 Esin Durmus, 5 Ondřej Dušek, 3 Chris Emezue, 21,30 Varun
arxiv-2102-01672.description: Abstract We introduce GEM , a living benchmark for natural language Generation (NLG), its Evaluation, and Metrics. Measuring progress in NLG relies on a constantly evolving ecosystem of automated metrics, datasets, and human evaluation standards. Due to this moving target, new models often still evaluate on divergent anglo-centric corpora with well-established, but flawed, metrics.

arxiv-2207-08664.title: Action-based Contrastive Learning for Trajectory Prediction
arxiv-2207-08664.creator: Marah Halawa, Olaf Hellwich, Pia Bideau
arxiv-2207-08664.description: Abstract Trajectory prediction is an essential task for successful human-robot interaction, such as in autonomous driving. In this work, we address the problem of predicting future pedestrian trajectories in a first-person view setting with a moving camera. To that end, we propose a novel action-based contrastive learning loss, that utilizes pedestrian action information to improve the learned trajectory embeddings.

arxiv-2211-06094.title: On the volume ratio of projections of convex bodies
arxiv-2211-06094.creator: Daniel Galicer, Alexander E. Litvak, Mariano Merzbacher, Damián Pinasco
arxiv-2211-06094.description: Abstract . We study the volume ratio between projections of two convex bodies. Given a high-dimensional convex body K K we show that there is another convex body L L such that the volume ratio between any two projections of fixed rank of the bodies K K and L L is large.

arxiv-2305-12084.title: Revisiting Entropy Rate Constancy in Text
arxiv-2305-12084.creator: Vivek Verma, Nicholas TomlinDan KleinComputer Science Division, University of California, Berkeley {vivekverma, nicholas_tomlin, klein}@berkeley.edu
arxiv-2305-12084.description: Abstract The uniform information density (UID) hypothesis states that humans tend to distribute information roughly evenly across an utterance or discourse. Early evidence in support of the UID hypothesis came from Genzel and Charniak 2002 , which proposed an entropy rate constancy principle based on the probability of English text under n n -gram language models.

arxiv-2306-05418.title: Weakly Supervised 3D Object Detection with Multi-Stage Generalization
arxiv-2306-05418.creator: Jiawei He, Yuqi Wang, Yuntao Chen, Zhaoxiang Zhang
arxiv-2306-05418.description: Abstract With the rapid development of large models, the need for data has become increasingly crucial. Especially in 3D object detection, costly manual annotations have hindered further advancements. To reduce the burden of annotation, we study the problem of achieving 3D object detection solely based on 2D annotations.

arxiv-2310-09617.title: How Good is ChatGPT in Giving Advice on Your Visualization Design? DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Journal: JACM Volume: 37 4 111 8 CCS: Human-centered computing Empirical studies in visualization CCS: Human-centered computing User studies
arxiv-2310-09617.creator: Nam Wook Kim, Yongsu Ahn, Grace Myers, Benjamin Bach
arxiv-2310-09617.description: Abstract . Data visualization creators often lack formal training, resulting in a knowledge gap in design practice. Large-language models such as ChatGPT , with their vast internet-scale training data, offer transformative potential to address this gap. In this study, we used both qualitative and quantitative methods to investigate how well ChatGPT can address visualization design questions.

arxiv-2502-05294.title: Hecke transformation for orthogonal bundles over curves
arxiv-2502-05294.creator: Christian Pauly, Hacen Zelaci
arxiv-2502-05294.description: Abstract . Given an orthogonal bundle E E over a smooth projective curve X X we define a Hecke transformation in the moduli space of orthogonal bundles by performing an elementary transformation with respect to a Lagrangian submodule L ⊂ E 2 ​ x L\subset E_{2x} at some point x ∈ X x\in X .

arxiv-2511-16728.title: Radio-Continuum Spectra of Pulsars with Free-Free Thermal Absorption
arxiv-2511-16728.creator: Mario G. Abadi, Gabriela Castelletti, Namir E. Kassim
arxiv-2511-16728.description: Abstract The radio continuum spectra of pulsars (PSRs) exhibit a wide variety of shapes, that are interpreted as pure and broken power laws, power laws with turnovers or cut-offs, and logarithmic-parabolic profiles. A notable fraction of these have well-defined power laws with ν − 2.1 \nu^{-2.1} exponential turnovers, indicative of free-free thermal absorption along the line-of-site.

arxiv-2602-13166.title: Optimal Take-off under Fuzzy Clearances
arxiv-2602-13166.creator: Hugo Henry, Arthur Tsai, Dr. Kelly Cohen
arxiv-2602-13166.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Hugo Henry, Arthur Tsai, Dr. Kelly Cohen. This paper presents a hybrid obstacle-avoidance architecture that integrates Optimal Control under clearance with a Fuzzy Rule-Based System (FRBS) to enable adaptive constraint handling for unmanned aircraft. Motivated by the limitations of classical optimal control under uncertainty and the need for interpretable decision-making in safety-critical aviation systems, we design a three-stage Takagi–Sugeno– Kang fuzzy layer that modulates constraint radii, urgency levels, and activation decisions based on regulatory separation minima and airworthiness guidelines from FAA and EASA.

arxiv-2606-13755.title: Position: Align AI to Our Aspirations, Not Our Flaws
arxiv-2606-13755.creator: Nikita Kazeev, Bui Nhat Huyen Phan

pmc-11400967.title: Bioinformatics analysis of the role of RNA modification regulators in polycystic ovary syndrome
pmc-11400967.creator: Kewei Quan, Shuting Ning, Zilin You, Gaopi Deng
pmc-11400967.description: PurposePolycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) is the most common metabolic and endocrine disorder affecting women of reproductive age. The pathogenesis of PCOS is influenced by factors such as race, genetics, environment, hyperandrogenemia, hyperinsulinemia, and obesity. However, the molecular mechanisms linking RNA modification and PCOS remain underexplored.

pmc-11409393.title: Effect of ketogenic diets on lipid metabolism in adults: protocol for a systematic review
pmc-11409393.creator: Serene Hilary, Linda Östlundh, Carine Platat, Rami H Al-Rifai, Osha Almehairbi, Fayeza Alshamsi, Habiba I Ali, Ayesha S Al Dhaheri, Leila Cheikh Ismail, Lily Stojanovska
pmc-11409393.description: AbstractIntroduction The ketogenic diet is a very low carbohydrate diet known for its ability to reduce weight and counteract hyperglycaemia. However, ketogenic diets recommend an increased intake of fats, raising concerns about cardiometabolic risk in adults. Due to the higher intake of fats in the ketogenic diet, there is significant variability in outcomes of lipid metabolism in the population.

pmc-11673831.title: Forces Acting on the Foot of the American Alligator (Alligator mississippiensis) During Pedal Anchoring
pmc-11673831.creator: Collin Walter, Jamie Carroll, Michael Cramberg, Jeremy J. Houser, Debra Loguda-Summers, Bruce A. Young
pmc-11673831.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryThe American alligator (Alligator mississippiensis) and other crocodylians brace themselves against being pulled forward by extending their hind feet (the pes) into the substrate, which is a behavior termed pedal anchoring. This study explored the mechanics of pedal anchoring by moving replica feet (which were equipped with strain gauges to detect forces) over a mud substrate to simulate locomotion and pedal anchoring.

pmc-11676757.title: Emotional Distress and Cardiovascular Health in Young Adults with Type 1 Diabetes
pmc-11676757.creator: Bethany L Armentrout, Bootan H Ahmed, Sineenat Waraphok, Johnathan Huynh, Stephanie Griggs, Paolo Emilio Puddu
pmc-11676757.description: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) is a complex chronic condition that places young adults aged 18–31 years at high risk for general and diabetes-related distress and poor cardiovascular health. Both general and diabetes distress are linked to higher A1C, a known risk factor for cardiovascular disease (CVD).

pmc-11859932.title: Increased emergency room visits without corresponding rehospitalizations in cannabis users with psychosis
pmc-11859932.creator: O Martin-Santiago, M Calvo-Valcarcel, P MartinezGimeno, C Alario-Ruiz, B Arribas-Simon
pmc-11859932.description: Introduction Epidemiological studies have established a complex relationship between cannabis consumption and a heightened risk of psychotic disorders, including schizophrenia. However, this connection is multifaceted, influenced by genetics, environment, and individual psychology. Surprisingly, despite a surge in emergency room (ER) visits associated with cannabis consumption and psychosis, there haven’t been significant increases in hospital readmissions.

pmc-13272386.title: The first pediatric emergency and critical care fellowship in sub-Saharan Africa: investing in local leaders to build subspecialty capacity in low- and middle-income countries
pmc-13272386.creator: Bhupi Reel, Rashmi Kumar, Mardi Steere, Emily A. Hartford, Arianna Shirk, Amelie von Saint Andre-von Arnim
pmc-13272386.description: Nearly 7 million children die annually worldwide mostly in the global South predominantly from treatable conditions. Pediatric emergency and critical care (PECC) systems are critically underdeveloped across low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), where healthcare worker shortages, limited infrastructure, and delayed presentation contribute to high rates of early in-hospital deaths.

pmc-13500856.title: NOP2-mediated m5C methylation impairs mitophagy and aggravates acute lung injury by targeting PINK1
pmc-13500856.creator: Xiaoyuan Chen, Rui Zhao, Hong Zhu, Yang Lu

pmc-13652425.title: Aggressive mediastinal amyloidosis mimicking malignancy: a case report
pmc-13652425.creator: Sergio Andres Siado Guerrero, Jorge Ramírez Pereira, María Paula Motta Aguirre, Yeni Alexandra Arroyave-Guerrero
pmc-13652425.description: Introduction:Amyloidosis is characterized by extracellular protein fibril deposition. Light-chain (AL) amyloidosis may be associated with plasma cell dyscrasias. Isolated mediastinal involvement is exceptionally rare and may mimic malignant tumors.Case presentation:A 69-year-old woman presented with a progressively enlarging anterior chest wall mass caused by an invasive mediastinal lesion. Biopsy revealed amyloid deposition.
